steps.label: The journal commit exists; the client has no acknowledgement.
The transport discards the reply after the commit.
Inquiry resolves the original payment identity through the terminal.
Retry the same identity and payload

scenarios.summary: The processor posts once. Its reply is lost. The terminal-only adapter inquires using the original payment identity.
scenarios.title: Committed, but not acknowledged

steps.label: The write is interrupted before delivery; the client cannot assume that.
Inquiry resolves the original payment identity through the terminal.
Inquire, then retry the same payment

scenarios.summary: The adapter cannot assume whether an interrupted write reached the processor. Inquiry returns not found; the retry keeps its original identity.
scenarios.title: The request did not arrive

steps.label: Open the fictional conversion-era business day
Verify the FIM ledger is clear
Prepare the EUR statement without a rounding adjustment
The clear FIM scope cannot hide an EUR break
Close with both declared scopes current and clear

scenarios.summary: A fictional 2002 integration converts the real day's FIM posting records. Individually rounded EUR items differ from the rounded aggregate. Both reconciliation scopes must be current and clear before closing.
scenarios.title: The euro statement leaves one cent unaccounted

targets.detail: Actual file-backed machine, byte terminal, payment adapter and journal replay
